# Taken 2026-10-30 on container 1.6.1 (macOS 27.0.1): first by asking the runtime directly, then
# through opossum built from this change, then docker compose v5.6.1 for comparison. Every
# container, network, project and directory was named for the run and removed afterwards; the
# last lines of the opossum part show none left. Progress lines (`[n/6] …`) are left out.
# The OPSM-217 advice in part (c) is what opossum printed when this was taken; it has since been
# changed to `opossum up --force-recreate <service>`, then `opossum up`, and `--remove-orphans`
# for a holder the project no longer has. The runtime's own lines are as measured.
#
# What the runtime does with `--network <name>,alias=<name>`:
# - A one-label alias is refused, with --dns-domain or without (B, B2).
# - An alias outside the DNS domain is taken, but no peer can look it up (A: dba.internal).
# - `<alias>.<project>.<domain>` is taken, and a peer with that search domain reaches it by the
#   short name (C, E); several on one network work (E).
# - Names are not kept apart by network: an alias given on p28probe-net2 alone is looked up from
#   a peer on p28probe-net, and resolves to the p28probe-net2 address (D). Whether that peer can
#   reach the address was not measured.
# - `<name>.internal.<project>.<domain>`: a glibc peer reaches `<name>.internal`, a musl peer
#   does not (F).
# - Capitals and `_` are taken; a label over 63 characters is refused (`label too long`).
# - Refused: an alias that is another container's name or the container's own, one another
#   container holds, the same alias on two networks, or twice on one. A name or an alias held by
#   a stopped container counts too (`hostname(s) already exist`, `alias(es) already exist`).
#   A refused run leaves no container.
#
# `system status --format json` reports the client version opossum reads to decide whether the
# runtime takes aliases (`client.version`); the paths in it are shortened to <user>.

$ container --version
container CLI version 1.6.1 (build: release, commit: unspeci)

########## the runtime asked directly: shapes A to E
$ container network create p28probe-net
--- exit code: 0
--- stdout ---
p28probe-net
--- stderr ---

$ container network create p28probe-net2
--- exit code: 0
--- stdout ---
p28probe-net2
--- stderr ---

# A: two-label alias, with opossum's DNS flags
$ container run -d --name srva.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=dba.internal --dns-domain opossum --dns-search p28probe.opossum alpine:3.20 sleep 600
--- exit code: 0
--- stdout ---
srva.p28probe.opossum
--- stderr ---

# B: one-label alias, with --dns-domain opossum
$ container run -d --name srvb.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=cacheb --dns-domain opossum --dns-search p28probe.opossum alpine:3.20 sleep 600
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
Error: alias "cacheb" must be a fully qualified name with at least 2 labels, such as "api.example.test". Configure a default DNS domain to have the domain added to a name that has none

# B2: one-label alias, no DNS flags
$ container run -d --name srvb2.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=cacheb2 alpine:3.20 sleep 600
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
Error: alias "cacheb2" must be a fully qualified name with at least 2 labels, such as "api.example.test". Configure a default DNS domain to have the domain added to a name that has none

# C: alias written as <alias>.<project>.<domain>
$ container run -d --name srvc.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=cachec.p28probe.opossum --dns-domain opossum --dns-search p28probe.opossum alpine:3.20 sleep 600
--- exit code: 0
--- stdout ---
srvc.p28probe.opossum
--- stderr ---

# D: two networks, the alias on the second only
$ container run -d --name srvd.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net --network p28probe-net2,alias=cached.p28probe.opossum --dns-domain opossum --dns-search p28probe.opossum alpine:3.20 sleep 600
--- exit code: 0
--- stdout ---
srvd.p28probe.opossum
--- stderr ---

# E: two aliases on one network
$ container run -d --name srve.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=e1.p28probe.opossum,alias=e2.p28probe.opossum --dns-domain opossum --dns-search p28probe.opossum alpine:3.20 sleep 600
--- exit code: 0
--- stdout ---
srve.p28probe.opossum
--- stderr ---

########## which aliases the runtime refuses
# capitals
$ container run -d --name s1.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=Cache.p28probe.opossum ... alpine:3.20 sleep 600
s1.p28probe.opossum
--- exit code: 0

# underscore
$ container run -d --name s2.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=cache_1.p28probe.opossum ... alpine:3.20 sleep 600
s2.p28probe.opossum
--- exit code: 0

# a 64-character label
$ container run -d --name s3.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.p28probe.opossum ... alpine:3.20 sleep 600
Error: invalid alias 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.p28probe.opossum': invalid DNS name: label too long: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
--- exit code: 1

# the name of another running container
$ container run -d --name s5.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=s4.p28probe.opossum ... alpine:3.20 sleep 600
Error: alias(es) already exist: ["s4.p28probe.opossum"]
--- exit code: 1

# its own name
$ container run -d --name s6.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=s6.p28probe.opossum ... alpine:3.20 sleep 600
Error: alias "s6.p28probe.opossum" is already a hostname of the container
--- exit code: 1

# an alias another container will also take (first)
$ container run -d --name s7.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=shared.p28probe.opossum ... alpine:3.20 sleep 600
s7.p28probe.opossum
--- exit code: 0

# the same alias on a second container
$ container run -d --name s8.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=shared.p28probe.opossum ... alpine:3.20 sleep 600
Error: alias(es) already exist: ["shared.p28probe.opossum"]
--- exit code: 1

########## the same alias on two networks, or twice on one
# the same alias on both networks of one container
$ container run -d --name t1.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=both.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net2,alias=both.p28probe.opossum ...
Error: alias "both.p28probe.opossum" is declared on more than one network
--- exit code: 1
# the same alias twice on one network
$ container run -d --name t2.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=twice.p28probe.opossum,alias=twice.p28probe.opossum ...
Error: alias "twice.p28probe.opossum" is listed more than once for network p28probe-net
--- exit code: 1

########## a name or an alias another container holds, running or stopped
# h1 holds the alias x.p28probe.opossum; a container named x.p28probe.opossum is then run
$ container run -d --name h1.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=x.p28probe.opossum --dns-domain opossum --dns-search p28probe.opossum alpine:3.20 sleep 600
h1.p28probe.opossum
--- exit code: 0

$ container run -d --name x.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net --dns-domain opossum --dns-search p28probe.opossum alpine:3.20 sleep 600
Error: hostname(s) already exist: ["x.p28probe.opossum."]
--- exit code: 1

# h1 stopped: does it still hold x.p28probe.opossum?
$ container stop h1.p28probe.opossum
h1.p28probe.opossum
--- exit code: 0

$ container run -d --name x.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net --dns-domain opossum --dns-search p28probe.opossum alpine:3.20 sleep 600
Error: hostname(s) already exist: ["x.p28probe.opossum."]
--- exit code: 1

$ container run -d --name h2.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=x.p28probe.opossum --dns-domain opossum --dns-search p28probe.opossum alpine:3.20 sleep 600
Error: alias(es) already exist: ["x.p28probe.opossum"]
--- exit code: 1

# h3 is stopped and holds the alias y.p28probe.opossum; h4 asks for the same alias
$ container run -d --name h3.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=y.p28probe.opossum --dns-domain opossum --dns-search p28probe.opossum alpine:3.20 sleep 600
h3.p28probe.opossum
--- exit code: 0

$ container stop h3.p28probe.opossum
h3.p28probe.opossum
--- exit code: 0

$ container run -d --name h4.p28probe.opossum --network p28probe-net,alias=y.p28probe.opossum --dns-domain opossum --dns-search p28probe.opossum alpine:3.20 sleep 600
Error: alias(es) already exist: ["y.p28probe.opossum"]
--- exit code: 1

# what is left of h2 and h4 after their refusals
(no h2 or h4)

########## opossum built from this change

########## (a) project p28real
# compose.yaml:
#   name: p28real
#   services:
#     db:
#       image: alpine:3.20
#       command: ["sleep", "300"]
#       networks:
#         back:
#           aliases: [cache, db.internal]
#         front:
#           aliases: [www]
#     other:
#       image: alpine:3.20
#       command: ["sleep", "300"]
#       networks:
#         back:
#           aliases: [cache]
#     client:
#       image: alpine:3.20
#       depends_on: [db, other]
#       networks: [back]
#       command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 3; for n in cache www db.internal db other; do echo \"== $$n\"; getent hosts $$n || echo '(none)'; done; sleep 300"]
#   networks:
#     back: {}
#     front: {}

$ opossum config
name: p28real
services:
    client:
        image: alpine:3.20
        command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - sleep 3; for n in cache www db.internal db other; do echo "== $$n"; getent hosts $$n || echo '(none)'; done; sleep 300
        networks:
            - back
        depends_on:
            db:
                condition: service_started
                required: true
            other:
                condition: service_started
                required: true
    db:
        image: alpine:3.20
        command:
            - sleep
            - "300"
        networks:
            - back
            - front
    other:
        image: alpine:3.20
        command:
            - sleep
            - "300"
        networks:
            - back
networks:
    back: {}
    front: {}

# fields opossum ignores (parsed but not acted on):
#   db: networks.back.aliases
--- exit code: 0

$ opossum up

  → [OPSM-217] another container holds this service's name as a network alias — one an earlier `opossum up` made, before a service took that name. Remove it (`opossum down`, then `opossum up`), or recreate the service that holds the alias (`opossum up --force-recreate <service>`), which no longer passes it

########## docker compose v5.6.1: a one-off run gives the service's aliases only with --use-aliases
$ docker compose version
Docker Compose version v5.6.1

# compose.yaml: services.a (alpine:3.20, sleep 60) with networks.back.aliases [kv]
$ docker compose -p p28dock run -d --name p28dock-plain a sleep 60
<container id>
$ docker compose -p p28dock run -d --use-aliases --name p28dock-alias a sleep 60
<container id>
$ docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{$k}}={{$v.Aliases}} {{end}}' p28dock-plain
p28dock_back=[p28dock-plain] 
$ docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{$k}}={{$v.Aliases}} {{end}}' p28dock-alias
p28dock_back=[p28dock-alias a kv]
